name: Speed
description: How fast the Wi-Fi of a TrimUI Brick or Smart Pro really is: download, upload and ping against the internet or a PC at home, a walk mode that shows where the Wi-Fi gives out, and a history. Drawn in Dot, the shared look of Kino, Musicdisk and Tuner.
author: evolver79

changelog.v1.1.0: New look, sized for the Brick's small screen: bigger text, dark glass cards on a violet ground, and the buttons in a bar along the bottom. The result screen is laid out for the bigger text, history shows five runs a page, and upload is drawn in blue.
changelog.v1.0.0: First release. Download, upload and ping over four connections, against LibreSpeed's public servers (open source; the quickest that answers) or a PC at home (tools/speed-server.py), drawn second by second as a dot graph, with what the slowest second means for streaming films. Walk mode (with the home server) keeps downloading while you move around and shows where the Wi-Fi gives out and when the Brick switches mesh points. History keeps the last 100 runs.
